_about: Batch B1b (Basics II) glossary: learn/prefix-caching, learn/tp-pp-in-practice, learn/quantized-checkpoints, learn/lora-adapters, learn/hf-checkpoints. Owner: the B1b writer.

hash-chain.short: A list of hashes where each hash also includes the hash before it. In prefix caching, the hash of a block names the whole prefix up to the end of that block.
hash-chain.long: vLLM hashes the tuple (parent hash, block token ids, extra keys) for each full block ({{cite vllm/v1/core/kv_cache_utils.py:707-737}}).

cache-salt.short: An optional secret string in a request. vLLM adds it to the hash of the first KV cache block, so only requests with the same salt share cached blocks.
cache-salt.long: Request field cache_salt ({{cite vllm/entrypoints/openai/chat_completion/protocol.py:499-511}}); used as an extra key of block 0 only ({{cite vllm/v1/core/kv_cache_utils.py:659-663}}).

column-parallel.short: A linear layer whose output columns are split across the tensor parallel GPUs. Each GPU computes its part of the output from the full input. vLLM class: ColumnParallelLinear.

row-parallel.short: A linear layer whose input rows are split across the tensor parallel GPUs. Each GPU makes a partial sum of the full output; an all-reduce adds them. vLLM class: RowParallelLinear.

all-reduce.short: A collective operation: every GPU in a group gives one tensor, and every GPU gets back the element-wise sum of all of them.

pipeline-bubble.short: Idle time of a pipeline stage. It waits for the stage before it, because there is not enough work in flight to keep every stage busy.

weight-only-quantization.short: Only the weights are stored in a small format (for example 4-bit integers). The kernel expands them and computes with 16-bit activations. Names: W4A16, W8A16; AWQ and GPTQ are examples.

w8a8.short: Weights and activations both in 8 bits (FP8 or INT8), so the matrix multiply itself runs in 8 bits. Each tensor has scales that map it back to real values.

kv-cache-quantization.short: Storing the keys and values of the KV cache in a smaller format, for example FP8, with scales. FP8 halves the KV memory per token compared with BF16. Set with --kv-cache-dtype.

lora-rank.short: The inner size r of a LoRA adapter: the update of a d_out x d_in weight is B (d_out x r) times A (r x d_in). Typical values are 8 to 64.

multi-lora.short: One server keeps one base model and several LoRA adapters. It runs requests with different adapters in the same batch; each token uses the adapter of its request.

safetensors.short: A file format for tensors: a JSON header with the name, dtype, shape and byte offsets of each tensor, then the raw bytes. Loading it runs no code.

hf-config.short: The config.json file of a model folder. It names the model class (architectures) and gives sizes such as hidden_size, num_hidden_layers and max_position_embeddings.

generation-config.short: The generation_config.json file of a model folder. It gives default sampling values (for example temperature, top_p) and EOS token ids. vLLM uses it by default.
